SELECT version.policy_document_version_id, version.policy_document_id, version.version_no, version.body, version.published_dttm, version.published_by_member_id, version.effective_from_dttm, version.is_required FROM policy_document_version version JOIN policy_document document ON document.policy_document_id = version.policy_document_id WHERE document.policy_type_code = #{policyType} AND document.audience_code = #{audience} AND document.is_active = 1 AND version.published_dttm <= #{currentDttm} AND version.effective_from_dttm <= #{currentDttm} ORDER BY version.effective_from_dttm DESC, version.version_no DESC, version.policy_document_version_id DESC LIMIT 1
